mechanism: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4, which may increase mycophenolate metabolite levels and enhance immunosuppressive effects; additionally, clarithromycin may reduce enterohepatic recirculation of mycophenolic acid.
action: Monitor for signs of mycophenolate toxicity (GI symptoms, bone marrow suppression); consider alternative antibiotics if possible or increase monitoring of MPA levels.
